mapper.select: SELECT s.scope_id, s.user_id, s.conversation_id, s.conversation_generation, s.kind, s.owner_id, s.account_id FROM sq_execution_scope s JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND s.del_flag = '0' AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.conversation_generation = c.generation AND ((s.kind = 'TASK' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_goal_task t WHERE t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.task_id = s.owner_id AND t.scope_id = s.scope_id AND t.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND t.del_flag = '0')) OR (s.kind = 'RESPONSE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution r WHERE r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.execution_id = s.owner_id AND r.scope_id = s.scope_id AND r.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND r.del_flag = '0')))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_budget_account (account_id, user_id, limit_microunits, profile_key, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{limit}, #{profileKey}, 'OPEN')

INSERT INTO sq_execution_scope (scope_id, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_generation, kind, owner_id, account_id) VALUES (#{scopeId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{generation}, #{kind}, #{ownerId}, #{accountId})
mapper.select: SELECT scope_id, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_generation, kind, owner_id, account_id FROM sq_execution_scope WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT scope_id FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT status, (cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested, del_flag FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{ownerId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT status, (cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested, del_flag FROM sq_response_execution WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{ownerId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'QUEUED', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status IN ('WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_interaction i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND i.status = 'OPEN' AND i.del_flag = '0')

UPDATE sq_response_execution SET status = 'QUEUED', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status IN ('WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_interaction i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND i.status = 'OPEN' AND i.del_flag = '0')
